results.agent_answer:

The warehouse has no ready-made revenue field, so I built this from the TPC-H-style `lineitem` table. If you define 1997 revenue by order date instead of ship date, the figure is about **$307.99 million** (9,130 line items). Let me know which basis your reporting uses.
